policy_defaults.source_authority: AviaSurveil360 transactional PostgreSQL source of record
policy_defaults.contract_family: Task 2 owner-decision required; v1 event API remains immutable predecessor
policy_defaults.grain: one source relation row and its revision/effectivity facts
policy_defaults.tenant_binding: authenticated platform tenant; never derived from organization payload
policy_defaults.organization_binding: inspected_or_owning_organization_id when the fact has one
policy_defaults.actor_organization_binding: separate actor organization or explicit CAA-null semantics
policy_defaults.visibility_purpose_scope: purpose-scoped governed feed; auditee, internal CAA, and operations visibility remain separate
policy_defaults.effective_time: preserve business effective time when defined; otherwise explicit not-applicable
policy_defaults.known_time: persisted created/updated/decision/receipt time; never substitute client clock
policy_defaults.producer_revision_sequence: source revision plus append-only sequence where available
policy_defaults.null_semantics: missing, unknown, redacted, and not-applicable remain distinct and closed
policy_defaults.correction_supersession: new immutable fact/event only; no in-place historical rewrite
policy_defaults.pii_class: P2 minimum; named restricted fields are P3/P4 and excluded from v1 inline payloads
policy_defaults.minimization_rationale: only a named data-product or lifecycle purpose may advance past candidate status
policy_defaults.retention_legal_hold_deletion: owner-approved indefinite immutable retention; legal hold restricts access/processing; tombstone suppresses replay/publication 30 days after hold release without physical deletion
policy_defaults.expected_volume: bounded by local profile manifest; realistic and stress profiles are not transport authority
policy_defaults.lineage: migration relation and source primary/business identifiers to future contract field lineage
policy_defaults.feature_label_eligibility: not training eligible; task-2 approval plus source-bound lineage required

field_policy.approved_v1_candidate_fields: only closed, schema-approved identifiers, status, version, effective/known time, and classified outcome fields
field_policy.sensitive_restricted: subject/person/contact, credential, raw request/session, organization-private and security fields
field_policy.forbidden_inline: unrestricted text, filenames, Evidence bytes, Internal CAA Notes, investigation notes, credentials and secret-bearing payloads
field_policy.remaining_fields: explicit Task 2 candidate or operational/DQ-only decision; a product is never a transport substitute

relation_dispositions.actor_organization_binding: actor organization header is retained only where the locked schema permits it
relation_dispositions.visibility_purpose_scope: regulated oversight only; no auditee projection or user/person data is stored
relation_dispositions.known_time: immutable producer known/emitted timestamps and append-only delivery receipt time
relation_dispositions.producer_revision_sequence: locked aggregate revision plus fenced delivery lease generation
relation_dispositions.null_semantics: actor organization, causation, and state-before retain explicit schema null semantics
relation_dispositions.correction_supersession: new locked correction/supersession event only; event bytes are never updated
relation_dispositions.pii_class: P2 headers; payload is encrypted and excludes forbidden locked-schema fields
relation_dispositions.minimization_rationale: durable local event delivery and exact AviaCore contract reconstruction only
relation_dispositions.retention_legal_hold_deletion: indefinite immutable retention; legal hold prevents tombstone; no physical deletion or crypto-erasure
relation_dispositions.expected_volume: bounded by producer transactional command volume and bounded delivery claims
relation_dispositions.consumer: Task 5 data-feed publisher only; no direct AviaCore database path
relation_dispositions.lineage: authoritative domain transaction to locked v3 event and append-only delivery state
relation_dispositions.feature_label_eligibility: not training eligible; producer transport rows are not analytics facts
